title: Summary Indices in Treatment Effect Estimation
abstract: arXiv:2609.21393v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper studies the practice of combining multiple outcomes into a summary index to estimate a causal effect. For common estimators and index constructions, the estimate equals a weighted sum of the estimated effects on the components, with weights that are implicit and rarely reported. The paper derives the weights and shows that, for inverse-covariance-weighted indices, they can be negative and unrestricted in magnitude, so the index effect can have the opposite sign to every component effect. The paper proposes two procedures for valid inference on the index effect: a variance estimator that accounts for the data-dependent weights, and a shifted t-test that requires no such correction. Conventional t-tests of the null of no effect remain valid. Contrary to common claims, summary indices do not generally improve power. Three published studies illustrate the results.

translated_title: 处理效应估计中的综合指数
translated_abstract: 本文研究了将多个结果变量合并为一个综合指数以估计因果效应的做法。对于常见的估计量和指数构建方法，该估计值等于各组成部分估计效应的加权和，而这些权重是隐式的且很少被报告。本文推导了这些权重，并表明对于逆协方差加权指数，权重可以为负且大小不受限制，因此指数效应可能与每个组成部分效应的符号相反。本文提出了两种对指数效应进行有效推断的方法：一种考虑数据依赖权重的方差估计量，以及一种无需此类校正的移位t检验。针对“无效应”零假设的传统t检验仍然有效。与常见说法相反，综合指数通常并不能提高检验功效。三篇已发表的研究结果印证了这些结论。
tldr: 本文推导了处理效应估计中综合指数的隐式权重，揭示逆协方差加权指数的权重可能为负且无界（导致指数效应符号可能与所有分量效应相反），提出了两种有效的推断方法，并证明综合指数通常并不能提高检验功效。
en_tdlr: This paper derives the implicit weights in summary index estimation of treatment effects, shows that inverse-covariance-weighted indices can have negative and unbounded weights—so the index effect may have the opposite sign to every component effect—proposes two valid inference procedures, and demonstrates that summary indices generally do not improve power.
